output.name: Released BOMs failing to transfer to SAP due to integration mapping errors
output.summary: Engineers release BOMs in PLM, but the transfer to SAP fails or never arrives, so plants keep seeing the old revision or no BOM at all and wait days for the integration team to fix it.

root_cause.text: Likely, the PLM-to-SAP BOM integration mapping is incomplete or out of date for some released BOMs, so transfers fail until the integration team corrects the mapping by hand and retries.

quotes.quote: Integration team corrected the mapping and retried the transfer.

evidence.text: Every ticket shown was resolved the same way: the integration team corrected the mapping and retried the transfer.

evidence.text: Failures are found by users rather than by monitoring, often days after release.

evidence.text: The failures hit several plants and part number ranges, so this is not one plant or product line.

output.fix: Have the integration team review the mapping corrections made on these tickets, fix the missing or incorrect mapping rules permanently in the PLM-to-SAP BOM interface, and add a check that blocks BOM release (or alerts integration support at once) when a BOM cannot be mapped.
